english.title: Act as member of flight crew of an aircraft registered in the UK without holding an appropriate licence
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) acted as a member of the flight crew of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AIRCRAFT/FLIGHT NUMBER..), without holding an appropriate licence granted or rendered valid under the Air Navigation Order 2009
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 50 and 241(7) of and Part C of Schedule 13 to the Air Navigation Order 2009.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
